summary: explain's impact strand builds registrations from built-in defs only and propagates liveness over @import arcs only, where the gate's reachable reads built-in+custom kinds and resolved+directive edges

edit.description: explain_target (~2470) and impact_one_impl (~2014): take the gate's registration map and its full arc set, never a private partial copy
registrations_by_kind (~1012) and the reachable edge chain become the one derivation both callers read
reachability_orphaned / reachable share the arc-set input
explain impact cases over a custom-kind registration and a declared-edge carrier

acceptance: explain's "reachability that dies with it" names exactly the members the gate's reachable would report dead with the target removed, for custom-kind registrations and declared edges alike
tests: explain impact names a custom-kind member kept live only by the explained member
explain impact names a member kept live only by a declared edge from the explained member
notes: Both read.rs sites claim READ-EDGE-UNIFY parity in their docs; the gate's inputs are gate.rs registrations_by_kind (overlaid built-ins chained with custom) and graph.rs ~1207 resolved.chain(directives).
